annotations.title: Look up an organization’s declared priority between two values

description: Ask one organization’s own norm file which of two AIO values it declared first, with the workshop record behind it (rule id, strength, declaration date, declared condition) and how that declaration lines up with the national legal norms (aligned_with / departs_from). A declaration is not a measurement and has passed no AIO review. Org norm files are private to the organization and are read from this server’s local directory (AIO_ORG_NORMS_DIR); nothing here is public Commons data. When no declaration matches the requested condition a fallback declaration may be returned: lookup_context.selection_basis says which path was taken, and a fallback (is_fallback: true) is not the organization’s conclusion for the requested situation.

condition.description: Situation axes. scale 1-5 (individual→society), reversibility 1-3 (reversible→irreversible), time 1-3 (immediate→long term); "U" means unspecified.

domain.description: Optional domain code to narrow the search, e.g. "MED".

org.description: Org slug as used in the file name, e.g. "example-hospital".
